title: Curbside
summary: Prospecting CRM in 4 countries (BR, PT, ES, US): collects leads from OpenStreetMap and Overture Maps, writes the outreach in each country's language and sends e-mails from a queue. Cloudflare Workers, D1 and a React Native app.
features: Runs in four countries: Brazil, Portugal, Spain and the US
Lead collection from OpenStreetMap and Overture Maps
Outreach written in each country's language
Sales funnel, analytics dashboard and automatic e-mail queue
16 fixes that came out of a security audit
Cloudflare Workers back-end with D1 and a React Native (Expo) app
